title: A fern made of smaller ferns
description: Show self-similarity: one leaf of a fern is a smaller copy of the whole fern.

title: Building the carpet: Steps 0, 1, 2
description: Shows how the Sierpinski Carpet is built by splitting every square into 9 and removing the centre, with the squares that remain counted at each step.

title: Each square becomes 8 squares
description: Shows the rule that every remaining square of the carpet turns into 8 remaining squares, so the count is multiplied by 8 at every step.

title: Holes: old ones stay, new ones join
description: Show that the holes at a step are the old holes plus one new hole for every square of the step before.

title: Grow the carpet: multiply by 8
description: Pictures the one move of the carpet stepper: going from one step to the next multiplies the remaining squares by 8.

title: Midpoints make 4 identical triangles
description: Shows that joining the midpoints of an equilateral triangle of side 8 cm cuts it into 4 identical equilateral triangles of side 4 cm.

title: Sierpinski Triangle at Step 3
description: Show the count of what remains at Step 3: 27 triangles, 13 holes, area 27/64.

title: Sierpinski Triangle: Steps 0, 1, 2
description: Shows the Sierpinski Triangle to Step 2 so the child sees remaining triangles multiply by 3.

topic_name: The Koch Snowflake and Fractals in Art
title: The bump rule: 1 side becomes 4
description: Shows the Koch bump rule on a single side: a side of length 1 is cut into thirds and the middle third is replaced by two sides of a small equilateral triangle, giving 4 sides of length 1/3.

topic_name: The Koch Snowflake and Fractals in Art
title: Each new shape has half the area
description: Show a nested diamond pattern in which each shape, made by joining midpoints, has half the area of the one around it.

topic_name: The Koch Snowflake and Fractals in Art
title: Koch Snowflake: 3 sides become 12
description: Shows the bump rule turning a triangle into a six pointed star, so the side count is multiplied by 4.

title: Cut the corners: two equal squares
description: Shows that cutting the four corners of a 4 cm square from midpoint to midpoint leaves a square of 8 square cm, and the four corners make another square of 8 square cm.

title: Cut at the thirds: hexagon or octagon?
description: Compare cutting corners at the thirds: the triangle leaves a regular hexagon, the square leaves an octagon that is not regular.

title: One tin can, two profiles
description: Shows that one solid gives different profiles from different viewpoints: a circle from above and a rectangle from the side.

title: One solid, two different profiles
description: Shows a tent shaped triangular prism that looks like a triangle from the front and a rectangle from the side.

title: Picture the profiles of a cylinder
description: Show the core move of the practice: picture a solid, then draw its outline from the side and from above.

topic_name: Faces, Edges and Vertices of Prisms and Pyramids
title: Faces, edges, vertices of a prism
description: Names a face, an edge and a vertex on one triangular prism and gives the three counts.

topic_name: Faces, Edges and Vertices of Prisms and Pyramids
title: A prism on a 10 sided base
description: Shows a prism whose two congruent faces have 10 sides, with its faces, edges and vertices counted.

topic_name: Faces, Edges and Vertices of Prisms and Pyramids
title: A pyramid on a 10 sided base
description: Show where the faces, edges and vertices of a pyramid on a 10 sided base come from.

topic_name: Faces, Edges and Vertices of Prisms and Pyramids
title: Octagonal prism and pyramid
description: Compares the prism and the pyramid on the same octagon with their counts of faces, edges and vertices.

topic_name: Nets of a Cube and a Cuboid
title: The cross net: opposite faces
description: Shows the cross shaped net of a cube with each pair of opposite faces in the same colour.

topic_name: Nets of a Cube and a Cuboid
title: Two squares land on one face
description: Show why six squares can fail to fold into a cube: two squares land on the same face.

topic_name: Nets of a Cube and a Cuboid
title: Net of a 4 by 2 by 1 cuboid
description: Shows a net of a cuboid made of three pairs of equal rectangles, drawn to scale.

topic_name: Nets of a Cube and a Cuboid
title: Fold six squares into a cube
description: Shows the core move of the net folder tool: a net of six squares folding into a cube, with opposite faces in matching colours.

title: Three faces meet at each corner
description: Compare a net of a regular tetrahedron with four triangles around one point, which cannot fold into one.

title: Cylinder net: 44 cm by 10 cm
description: Shows the net of a cylinder: a rectangle as long as the circumference, with a circle on each long side.

title: A cone unrolls into a sector
description: Shows a cone of base radius 5 cm and slant length 10 cm unrolling into a semicircle of radius 10 cm.

title: A net of an octahedron
description: Show one net of an octahedron: two fans of 4 equilateral triangles joined along one edge.

title: Flatten the box: a straight path
description: Shows the side face and top face of a cube laid flat so the shortest path is a straight line.

title: A slanted line to the edge
description: Shows the front and right faces of a 6 cm cube unfolded flat, with the shortest path from the ant to the laddu as one slanted straight line.

title: Unfold so the line stays on the net
description: Show the unfolding of the cuboid where the straight path from the ant to the laddu stays on the net, and its length.

title: The 40 cm path beats 42 cm
description: Shows the unfolding of the 30 by 12 by 12 box where the straight line is the side of a right triangle with legs 24 and 32, giving 40 cm.

title: Unfold the box, keep the length
description: Shows the core move of the path unfolder tool: the box is unfolded, the path keeps its length, and on the net the shortest path is a straight line.

topic_name: Projections of Points, Lines and Shapes
title: A projection is never longer
description: Show that a slanting stick, its projection and the height difference make a right triangle, so the projection is shorter.

topic_name: Projections of Points, Lines and Shapes
title: A tilted square projects to a rectangle
description: Shows a square card hinged on the floor and tilted so its far side is 3 cm up, and its projection, a 5 cm by 4 cm rectangle.

topic_name: Projections of Points, Lines and Shapes
title: Three solids, one circle
description: Shows that a cone, a cylinder and a ball, each of radius 4 cm, all project onto the floor as the same circle.

topic_name: Projections of Points, Lines and Shapes
title: Tilted rod, then parallel rod
description: Compare a tilted rod with a shorter projection and the same rod held parallel, whose projection is its full length.

title: Three planes, three views
description: Shows a cylinder inside three perpendicular planes with its front view, top view and side view drawn on them.

title: Three views of 4 cubes
description: Shows a stack of 4 cubes (3 in a row, 1 on top of the left cube) and its front, top and side views.

title: Three views of a cone
description: Show the front, top and side views of one standing cone.

title: A torch makes a bigger shadow
description: Shows in a side view how rays from a torch spread so the shadow on the wall is twice the toy's height.

title: A square card's shadow is a rhombus
description: Shows a square card with 10 cm diagonals tilted in sunlight about one diagonal, casting a rhombus shadow with diagonals 10 cm and 6 cm whose opposite sides stay parallel.

title: Views of a C made of cubes
description: Show a stack of 8 identical cubes shaped like a C and its three views.

title: Cube on a corner: a regular hexagon
description: Shows the isometric projection of a glass cube balanced on a corner: a regular hexagon with 6 equal spokes inside.

title: A 2 by 2 by 2 cube on the grid
description: Shows a 2 by 2 by 2 cube drawn on an isometric grid, its 9 visible edges coloured by direction, each 2 units.

title: A cuboid on the isometric grid
description: Show a 1 by 2 by 3 cuboid on an isometric grid with each family of parallel edges in its own colour.

title: One cube on isometric paper
description: Pictures the simplest state of the isometric grid builder: one unit cube on the grid with its three drawing directions.

title: Fractals, nets and views
description: A three item visual summary of the chapter: fractals repeat a rule, nets fold into solids, views put solids on paper.
